task: Video authored Focus follows native keyboard descendants and survives facade replacement

behavior.nodeFocus: wrapper Focus declarations activate from a focus-visible facade button or native video, and from a keyboard-marked iframe while it retains focus-within
behavior.classFocus: generic class selector retained and Video descendant bridge added at every breakpoint
behavior.pointerSemantics: direct pointer activation creates no marker; pointerdown on a keyboard-opened iframe clears its marker when the parent document receives that event
behavior.blurSemantics: iframe blur clears the keyboard-origin marker, so later pointer re-entry cannot reactivate authored Focus from stale keyboard state
behavior.cascade: local Video Focus remains after reusable class Focus
behavior.editor: uses the same generated selector; no separate state simulation exists in Core
behavior.facadeRuntime: facade replacement records keyboard origin before replacement, focuses the iframe, and clears the marker on iframe blur or parent-visible pointerdown

limitations: Root owns final native keyboard, iframe blur, pointer re-entry, and editor canvas acceptance.
Cross-origin iframe-internal pointer events do not reliably reach the parent; stale keyboard state is cleared by the iframe blur event instead.
